blocks.text: Condo buildings in Langley City

The langleycity page is NOT a listing feed: headed "Langley City Land Use Plans & Development Maps," it carried no MLS listing cards and no result count at reading; it is a City of Langley land-use / OCP / zoning information page that links out for inventory ("For current MLS® inventory, see City of Langley homes for sale"). The City of Langley is a separate municipality from the Township of Langley, with its own council, OCP and zoning bylaw.
Parkway Estates — 5360 205 Street, Langley City

Built 1988, 54 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records the restrictions as: age restrictions, pets not allowed, rentals not allowed — the rental line is VOID since November 24, 2022. Amenities listed: elevator, guest suite, in-suite laundry, recreation centre, storage, wheelchair access. Listings describe the community as 55+ (Parkway).
Parkway II — 5363 206 Street, Langley City

Built 1989, 42 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records the same restriction set: age restrictions, pets not allowed, rentals not allowed — the rental line is VOID since November 24, 2022. Amenities listed: elevator, guest suite, in-suite laundry, recreation centre, wheelchair access, workshop. Listings describe it as a 55+ community ("Parkway II" / "Parkway Two") whose strata fee covers hot water, gas, electricity and heat, with a recently completed full roof replacement stated in one listing — a listing claim, not a verified strata record.
Glenmont Park — 5375 205 Street, Langley City

Built 1990, 3 storeys, wood-frame construction (listing data). A full MLS data sheet for a unit in the building records "Units in Strata: 43," a 55+ age restriction, and no cats and no dogs permitted; listings describe a 55+ community whose strata fee includes electricity, gas and hot water, with a guest suite, workshop, clubhouse and RV parking. Unit count is from that MLS data sheet (secondary source), not a building directory — treat it as published-but-single-source.
Morningside Estates — 5365 205 Street, Langley City: Not confirmed
It is held here as not confirmed and is NOT counted.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Langley City

items.t: Zoning — City of Langley Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300 (cite the NUMBER; adoption date not verified): Bylaw No. 3300 repeals Zoning Bylaw 1996 No. 2100 (cited at s.1.1 of the new bylaw).

Secondary suites (Bylaw No. 3300): a suite must not exceed the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the gross floor area of the building (s.1.3 / s.2.4(c)); the registered owner must reside on the lot; at least one off-street parking space is required in addition to the two normally required for a single detached use; and the suite must be inspected, approved through a building permit and recorded in the City's secondary suites registry. Garden suites and carriage homes (s.2.4(d)) are permitted in the R1 zone, with a maximum gross ground floor area of 100 m², a maximum total floor area of accessory buildings on an R1 lot of 60 m², and the registered owner residing on the lot.

ALR block (for completeness — no City ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31).

Bare-land strata block (for the form — no City bare-land strata plan is verified): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for 5+ lots since Jul 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since Nov 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since Nov 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions; a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. Longlea Estates, if purchased as strata, would sit under this block — it is QUEUED here, so the block is stated for the form only.

What a duplex looks like in Langley City

items.t: The usual duplex form: A half duplex exists only where the parcel was strata-divided into a 2-lot plan or subdivided fee-simple.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Langley City

items.t: City — zoning: City of Langley Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300 repeals Zoning Bylaw 1996 No. 2100 (cited at s.1.1 of the new bylaw). The Township of Langley's zoning frame does not govern any City property.

City — OCP and SSMUH: The City's Official Community Plan was adopted on November 22, 2021, built on the "Nexus of Community" vision adopted July 23, 2018. SSMUH: The City amended its Zoning Bylaw to permit small-scale multi-unit housing on RS1 and RS2 lots by Bylaw No. 3284, adopted June 17, 2024 (City-only) — RS1/RS2 permit 4 units, and 6 units if within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Duplexes are the baseline form inside that framework: A two-unit building sits below the 4-unit permission.

Under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300: A secondary suite must not exceed the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the gross floor area of the building (s.1.3 / s.2.4(c)); the registered owner must reside on the lot (s.2.4(c)(i) owner-occupancy); a suite must provide at least one off-street parking space in addition to the two normally required for a single detached use, and must be inspected, approved through a building permit and recorded in the City's secondary suites registry. A listing's "suite" claim is a claim to verify against this rule.

faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings does Langley City actually have?
faq.a: Huntsfield Green is a fourth strata name buyers meet constantly, but it is townhouse-form and is not an apartment condo. Morningside Estates (5365 205 St) is not confirmed and is not counted.

faq.q: The Parkway directory says rentals are banned and it's 55+. Which one binds me?
faq.a: The rental line does not — rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022. The 55+ line can: a 55-or-older bylaw is the one age bylaw the Strata Property Act still permits (ss. 123.1/123.2), with exemptions for legacy residents, live-in caregivers and (since May 1, 2023) younger spouses/partners and defined children. Both Parkway buildings are directory-recorded with age restrictions, pets not allowed and rentals not allowed; read only the age and pet lines as potentially live, and confirm both on the registered bylaws.

faq.q: What are Langley City's secondary suite rules?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300, a suite must not exceed the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, the registered owner must reside on the lot, at least one extra off-street parking space is required, and the suite must be permitted, inspected and recorded in the City's secondary suites registry. A listing's "suite" claim is a claim to verify against those rules.

faq.q: Is Langley City the same market as the Township of Langley?
faq.a: No — separate municipalities, separate OCPs and zoning bylaws.

faq.q: Is Huntsfield Green a condo or a townhouse complex?
faq.a: Townhouse-form — gated rancher/bungalow townhouses, strata plan NWS3354, verified 55+.

faq.q: Is 5365 205 Street the same complex as Glenmont Park?
faq.a: No. Glenmont Park is 5375 205 St (43 units in strata on an MLS data sheet, 55+).

faq.q: What are the City's suite rules?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300: the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, owner-occupancy, one extra off-street parking space, and permit/inspection/registry recording.

faq.q: Is Langley City the same as the Township of Langley for land rules?
faq.a: No — the City is a separate municipality with its own OCP (adopted November 22, 2021) and its own Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300; the Township has its own bylaws, and the two must never be mixed. A Township rule applied to a City lot is an error.

faq.q: Can I buy just half of a City duplex?
faq.a: Only if that half is legally separate — a strata lot in a 2-lot strata plan, or its own fee-simple lot after subdivision approval. A duplex never strata-divided or subdivided sells whole, building and lot together.

faq.q: What are Langley City's secondary suite rules for a duplex?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300, a suite must not exceed the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, the registered owner must reside on the lot, at least one extra off-street parking space is required, and the suite must be permitted, inspected and recorded in the City's secondary suites registry.

faq.q: Is Morningside Estates the same as Glenmont Park?
faq.a: No — and they must never be merged. Glenmont Park is 5375 205 St, verified, 55+, 43 units in strata per an MLS data sheet.

faq.q: Is Langley City the same as the Township of Langley?
faq.a: No — the City of Langley is a separate municipality with its own Official Community Plan (adopted November 22, 2021, built on the Nexus of Community vision) and its own Zoning Bylaw, 2025, No. 3300; the Township has its own bylaws, and the two must not be mixed (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).
